name: Senior US designer seeking reduced hours with caregiving commitments

context.employment_state: Employed; selectively exploring a sustainable reduced-hours move
constraints: Caregiving responsibilities require agreed working hours
context.company_awareness: Selective company list; willing to add employers with explicit reduced-hours arrangements

trigger: Finds many remote senior roles but none clearly state fewer hours or a viable job-share arrangement.

searches_run.query: senior product designer part time jobs United States
searches_run.observation: Retrieval included broad senior-design boards, part-time consulting and contract listings. A direct employer PDF described remote US part-time design, but it did not establish senior scope, exact hours or job-share support.

searches_run.query: product designer job share part time 20 hours United States
searches_run.observation: Results included 20-hour weekly contracts, a fractional role offering 20–30 hours monthly and a historical three-month engagement. No explicit current job-share arrangement was verified; hours units and duration materially differ.

sources.title: Senior Product Designer US — Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieved category mixes a part-time role with full-time senior roles; no fitting-vacancy count is inferred.

sources.title: Product Designer Part-Time — Classic Learning Test
sources.supports: Direct employer PDF states part-time and remote within the US, with scheduling flexibility; exact hours, job sharing and senior-level scope are not established.

sources.title: Fractional Product Systems Designer — Serious Development
sources.supports: Retrieved employer result states US-based remote work and 20–30 hours per month, illustrating why fractional is not equivalent to a regular part-time week.

sources.title: Senior Product Designer Contract — Jobgether
sources.supports: Retrieved intermediary listing states approximately 20 hours weekly for 60–90 days, with possible full-time transition; neither job share nor ongoing part-time employment is established.

best_entry_page.primary_query: senior product designer part time US
best_entry_page.promise: Compare reduced-hours design opportunities by weekly commitment, duration, senior scope and stated US location rules, while distinguishing job share from contracting.
best_entry_page.cta: Compare explicit hours and role terms
proof_needed: Separate temporary contract, permanent part-time and job-share statements
Missing hours or job-share policy left unknown
New indexable guide; existing search/company pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Does part-time mean twenty hours per week or per month?
Is reduced workload matched by realistic responsibilities?
Are meetings compatible with my stated availability?
Is this an ongoing role or a short project?
Can a job share actually be discussed with this team?

avoid_targeting.query: remote jobs for caregivers guaranteed flexible
avoid_targeting.reason: Remote location does not establish schedule flexibility.

avoid_targeting.query: senior product designer job share guaranteed

avoid_targeting.reason: Benefits/legal advice is outside product scope.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I want to keep doing senior design work with fewer, agreed hours. Show the weekly commitment and team expectations before calling a role flexible; working from home does not solve the schedule by itself.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona. Exactly two searches and one direct employer PDF inspected. No specific caregiving schedule, gender or capability assumption. No employer arrangement, benefit or vacancy availability guaranteed. Other rows are hypotheses; job share remains an unmet evidence need rather than an observed offering.
